name: Trusted server-context adapter for private menu runtime
phase: Discovery and specification only; implementation requires separate explicit authorization
purpose: Assemble the injected menu runtime from trusted server dependencies and a request-scoped Astro-like session, reusing identity components unchanged. Acquire no globals and expose no route or UI.
discovery: FOOD-002I synchronously extracts one named FoodD1Database and preserves exact identity; no composition or administrator/session acquisition.
FOOD-002H synchronously constructs one repository/service/workspace graph from database, readDependencies, callerResolver and administratorPrincipalId; constructor failures are fixed TypeErrors.

FOOD-001G precedent validates supplied session and RIVER_IDENTITY_DB, constructs fresh identity components and forwards the original environment. Its draft acquisition/composition functions must not be called for menu assembly.

AstroPrincipalSessionStore constructor stores session/clock without invoking either. getSession awaits async or sync get, preserves malformed/expired cleanup and propagates rejected reads to resolver unavailable.
D1PrincipalRepository and DefaultSessionPrincipalResolver construction perform no I/O. Principal lookup occurs only during later resolve. No additional shared compatibility correction is required.

factory.name: createPrivateFoodMenuRuntimeFromServerContext
factory.inputDefinition: export interface FoodPrivateMenuServerContextInput { readonly environment: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>; readonly bindingName: string; readonly session: AstroSessionLike; readonly readDependencies: FoodMenuReadDependencies; readonly administratorPrincipalId: PrincipalId; readonly now?: () => Date; }
factory.resultDefinition: export type FoodPrivateMenuServerContextResult = Readonly<{ ok: true; value: FoodPrivateMenuRuntimeCapabilities }> | Readonly<{ ok: false; error: Readonly<{ code: 'configuration-unavailable'; message: 'Food menu database configuration is unavailable.' }> }>;
factory.success: Object.freeze({ ok: true, value: capabilities }) where capabilities is exactly H's frozen service/workspace bundle, not a clone or alternate graph.
factory.failure: Object.freeze({ ok: false, error: Object.freeze({ code: 'configuration-unavailable', message: 'Food menu database configuration is unavailable.' }) }); use I's existing fixed configuration failure vocabulary/message without exposing dependency values or exception details.
factory.trust: All inputs are supplied by trusted integration, never body/query/cookie configuration. session is the request-appropriate session capability; not raw cookies or complete Astro context.

ownership: I remains sole validator of menu bindingName and selected database prepare/batch capability. J passes the exact original environment and bindingName without normalization or alternate lookup.
J validates only its own environment identity dependency RIVER_IDENTITY_DB and session/clock/read/admin construction dependencies. No production menu key is selected here.
H remains menu composition authority; E remains fresh single-admin authorization authority; G/D remain persistence/serialization/concurrency authorities; F remains workspace presentation authority.
readDependencies remain injected exact getProduct/getRecipe capabilities. Do not acquire a draft database, construct draft runtime/repository or perform FOOD-001 reads here.
administratorPrincipalId remains a trusted canonical injection, validated through parsePrincipalId unchanged. No environment administrator key, concrete value, inference or defaults.
structuralValidation: Capture environment, bindingName, session, readDependencies, administratorPrincipalId and now once in that order from a non-null non-array outer object; reject throwing access with fixed failure.
Require environment, session, readDependencies and environment.RIVER_IDENTITY_DB to be non-null non-array objects. Read identity binding once; never scan alternates.

Require callable session get/set/delete/regenerate/destroy. Preserve get unknown | Promise<unknown>, synchronous set/delete, asynchronous regenerate and void | Promise<void> destroy; do not call methods to inspect behavior.

Require identity database.prepare callable only; batch is not required. Do not acquire/probe prepared statements during construction; later principal reads use bind/first through the unchanged identity repository.
Require callable readDependencies.getProduct/getRecipe without invocation; require canonical administrator through parsePrincipalId without trimming/normalization/coercion.

Omitted/undefined now uses AstroPrincipalSessionStore's default; callable now is forwarded exactly; explicit null/noncallable or throwing clock getter fails. Never invoke the clock during construction.
Validate all J-owned dependencies before invoking I or constructing identity components. Catch all malformed/throwing dependencies; no fallback, cached graphs or partial output.
constructionFlow: Validate J-owned dependencies structurally and canonically.

Invoke acquirePrivateFoodMenuDatabaseFromEnvironment({ environment: originalEnvironment, bindingName: originalBindingName }). On failure return that exact I result unchanged and construct no identity/menu components.
On acquisition success construct one fresh AstroPrincipalSessionStore(session, now), one D1PrincipalRepository(identityDatabase), and one DefaultSessionPrincipalResolver({ sessions, principals }).

Invoke createPrivateFoodMenuRuntimeComposition({ database: acquired.value, readDependencies: originalReadDependencies, callerResolver: newResolver, administratorPrincipalId: canonicalInjectedAdministrator }).
Return frozen success with exact H capabilities. Catch H or identity constructor failures into the fixed configuration failure; never modify H's own behavior or error contract.
Repeat this graph construction per invocation; supplied dependencies may be shared intentionally, but no module-level resolver/service/repository/session cache.
constructionPurity: Synchronous and I/O-free. Zero session methods, clock calls, identity/menu prepare/batch/statement calls, principal resolution, FOOD-001 reads, service/workspace/repository operations, schema probes or migrations.
No cloudflare:workers, globals, process.env, import.meta.env, Astro locals acquisition, raw request/cookies/body, redirects, Response construction or runtime binding discovery.
Structural success proves no environment provenance, live database/schema/migration availability, consistency, active session, principal activity, authorization, public publication or sale readiness.
laterOperations: E resolves fresh for every service operation and before input validation/repository access. Workspace aggregate retains two distinct authorization resolutions.

Async Astro reads are awaited. Missing session yields unauthenticated; malformed/expired resolved session retains deletion and expiry boundary rules. Rejected reads yield access-unavailable without malformed cleanup or principal lookup.
Missing/inactive/mismatched principal preserves session destruction behavior; cleanup/storage failures fail closed. Sync and async destruction remain supported.
Identity database queries may legitimately occur during later authorization, but denied menu operations perform zero menu database or FOOD-001 dependency calls.
Exact identities/versions/predecessors/cursors/references/outcomes pass through unchanged; no latest substitution, retry, activation or interpretation of published state as public access.
privacy: Expose only service/workspace through H capabilities. No database, environment, bindingName, identity repository, session, resolver, admin/principal, read dependencies or permission token fields.
Fixed configuration failures reveal no key/ID/config values, thrown getter messages, SQL details or stack traces. Later operation failures retain existing E/F fixed messages and codes.
Freeze result containers only; do not deep-freeze injected dependencies or concrete class instances. Preserve H/F existing immutability.
tests: Valid synchronous service/workspace-only result; zero construction calls including clock, sessions, identity/menu DB, FOOD-001 and resolver operations.

Instrument constructor/delegation seams following existing G/H tests: exact original environment/bindingName to I; exact acquired database/read/admin and new resolver to H; exact H output preserved; one fresh identity/menu graph each invocation.

Every malformed/null/array/throwing outer/session/identity/read dependency, each required noncallable session method and noncanonical administrator fails before I/identity construction. Identity batch not required.
Omitted/undefined/callable clocks preserve semantics; explicit null/noncallable/throwing clock rejected without invocation.
I failure unchanged and no downstream identity/H construction; H constructor failures sanitized; no fallback or alternate binding/key validation duplicated in J.

Genuinely async session fake: delayed valid reads, missing/malformed/expired/boundary cases, rejected reads with no cleanup/lookup, cleanup exceptions, exact canonical principal lookup, inactive/missing/mismatched principal and synchronous/asynchronous destruction.
Request isolation, fresh authorization/revocation and wrong-admin denial; identity lookup allowed but denied operations make zero menu DB/FOOD-001 calls.
Authorized exact operation arguments/outcomes and frozen workspace presentation preserved; no implicit public activation.
Source isolation: no globals/HTTP/routes/UI/session recreation/identity schema/runtime config/gate/transport/payment or unrelated subsystems; no configured database is used in tests.
